secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for GPT-4o content generation and image generation. Get it from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys.

secrets.name: BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN
secrets.description: Vercel Blob read/write token for storing illustrations and shared materials. Created automatically when connecting a Blob Store to the project on Vercel.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth client ID for login. Get it from Google Cloud Console → Credentials → OAuth client ID (Web application type).

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Google OAuth client secret for login. Get it from Google Cloud Console → Credentials → OAuth client ID.

secrets.name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret that signs the session. Optional — if omitted, it is derived from BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN.
